_about: Strong scaling with two-level gradient sync (ADR-0020), from strong-scaling-two-level.log in this directory. Read by scripts/make_perf_charts.py.

strong_scaling.subtitle: A CNN on 32,768 images, 2 epochs; GCP n1-standard-4, 4 processes per machine, gloo; same machines for both
strong_scaling.method: Wall time from start until the last process exits, median of 3 interleaved runs, both trainers on the same machines (GPUlayer pinned with worker_ids). GPUlayer uses two-level gradient sync (the default with gloo); Lightning its default DDP under torchrun.
